tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and observed curvature support the two-layer siphon family, but the supplied archive leaves its branch term explicitly open. A targeted branch-discriminating observation is the lowest-cost way to resolve that genuine model ambiguity.

considered_alternatives.option: author a static two-layer siphon model with an open branch term
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five rows do not resolve the branch term's sign/form (±c_loc·sqrt(u_n) versus −leak_rate·u_n), so fitting now risks selecting the wrong extrapolating law.
The evidence favors a static monotone-concave siphon law, not the coupled memory ODE that this batch is designed to identify.
All current measurements share H=0.6 and show no indication of horizon-dependent reversal; this probe is less direct than resolving the open branch.
Auxiliary high-variance measurements do not address the branch ambiguity.
